prompt: Convert to a JSON object: name=Ada, role=engineer, team=platform. Reply with ONLY the JSON.
What year was the first moon landing? Answer with just the year.
Rewrite in Title Case, reply with only the rewritten text: 'the switchyard routes every train'
How many values are in this CSV row: a,b,c,d,e? Answer with just the number.
Extract the email address from: 'Contact Ada at ada@example.com for details.' Reply with only the email address.
Convert 2 hours to minutes. Answer with just the number.
Alice is taller than Bob. Bob is taller than Carol. Dana is shorter than Carol. Who is the second-shortest person? Answer with just the name.
A team ships 3 features per sprint. Each feature needs 2 reviews and each review takes 45 minutes. How many review-HOURS does the team spend across a 4-sprint quarter? Answer with just the number.
What does this Python print? x=[1,2,3]; y=x; y.append(4); print(len(x)) — answer with just the number.
Server A: p95=210ms, error rate 0.2%. Server B: p95=180ms, error rate 1.4%. The SLO requires error rate < 0.5% AND p95 < 250ms. Which server meets the SLO? Answer with just the letter.

Tasks: build(3d) depends on design(2d); test(2d) depends on build; docs(1d) depends on design and can run parallel to build/test. What is the minimum total days to finish everything? Answer with just the number.
In exactly 3 bullet points, explain to a product manager why routing between a small open model and a large frontier model can cut cost dramatically while losing little accuracy.

check.value: Award PASS only if the answer has ~3 bullets and mentions (a) that most calls are easy / calls differ in difficulty, and (b) that only a minority of calls need the expensive model.
